correctness.rationale: Every pendant leaf of a restrained Italian labeling must be 1 or 2: leaf zero with root zero fails Italian neighbor sum, and leaf zero with positive root is isolated in zero-induced graph. Thus zero set S consists only of roots and is admissible iff G[S] has no isolated vertices. For each fixed S, n-|S| outside root/leaf pairs each contribute (z+z²)²; b(S) boundary zero roots have freely 1/2-labeled leaves; |S|-b(S) interior zeros force leaf 2. Product gives exact stated polynomial. Nonnegative distinct terms imply minimum 2n-max b and count of optimizers. On C_n every proper admissible S decomposes into k cyclic 1-runs >=2 and 0-gaps >=1, b=2k. Composition of s selected and n-s unselected into k runs and gaps gives n/k binom(s-k-1,k-1) binom(n-s-1,k-1); k≤floor(n/3). Maximize k to derive minimum 2n-2floor(n/3) and #min n/k binom((n-3k)+2k-1,2k-1). Independent direct ternary enumerations for all 12 graphs on n<=3 incl empty/disconnected bases matched polynomial. The infinite formula follows by case decomposition, not finite checks.
